questions.stemHtml: Osteopetrosis is a congenital metabolic bone disease caused by defective osteoclastic resorption of the immature bone that presents with an increased frequency of long bone fractures, cranial nerve palsies, and low back pain. Which of the following most accurately describes the cause of osteopetrosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Decreased mineralisation of the osteoid matrix

options.label: B
options.text: Decreased expression of type I collagen

options.label: C
options.text: Loss-of-function of carbonic anhydrase II gene
